title: Format every member of a selected nested Cargo workspace
goal: Run the nested workspace format check from its own directory so a virtual manifest and a manifest with a root package both format their members. Verify a clean virtual workspace passes, an unformatted non-default member fails, and an independently rooted path dependency is outside that format check. Preserve the root checks, the existing nested host and cross checks and required second-phase failure propagation. Report the working directory in the gate output.
